configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Unoptimised, full debug info. No sanitizer (combine with asan/ubsan presets for that).

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Optimised, no debug info -- for benchmarking and shipping.

configurePresets.name: relwithdebinfo
configurePresets.description: Optimised with debug info -- this project's own default build type (see CMakeLists.txt) and what every benchmark/baseline document in docs/ was measured with.

configurePresets.name: asan
configurePresets.description: RelWithDebInfo build with ASan+UBSan (deliberately NOT CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Debug: Clang's ASan runtime and the Windows Debug CRT (ucrtbased.dll/MSVCP140D.dll) both try to manage the heap at process exit on this toolchain, which aborts as a 'bad-free' inside the CRT's own teardown code on every binary -- reproduced on trivial, unmodified tests, so it is an environment interaction, not a real bug; see docs/VALIDATION.md). Needs the sanitizer runtime DLL directory on PATH at run time on Windows -- see docs/BASELINE.md.

configurePresets.name: tsan
configurePresets.description: Debug build with TSan. Not supported for the x86_64-pc-windows-msvc target on at least one Clang build this project was developed with (see docs/BASELINE.md) -- configures cleanly, may fail to compile on that toolchain.

configurePresets.name: benchmark
configurePresets.description: Release build with benchmarks on, examples/CLI off until those are populated.

configurePresets.name: portable
configurePresets.description: SIMD kernels off -- for a machine without AVX2. The library and every test/benchmark must still build and pass; only the AVX2-specific kernel tests (tests/kernels/erfcx_avx2.cpp) are skipped by this flag going to OFF.

configurePresets.name: native
configurePresets.description: Non-portable: compiled for this exact machine's CPU. Never the build other machines' measurements are compared against.
